seo.title: Online Yoga App UI/UX Case Study | Shubham Pendse
seo.description: A complete mobile yoga app UI/UX case study by Shubham Pendse, covering UX structure, user experience thinking and the final mobile interface designed in Figma.

sections.heading: Project overview
sections.body: This project explores an online yoga mobile app from both sides of the design process: the UX structure that shapes the experience and the UI system that brings it to life visually. Together, the two case studies show how the concept moved from organizing the mobile journey to designing a clear, polished interface for a health and wellness audience.

sections.heading: UX case study
sections.body: The UX presentation focuses on the structure of the mobile experience and the thinking behind how the app is organized for users.
